title: Top notch tour guide in Carmona
text: Luca was an exceptional tour guide!  Very knowledgeable and friendly.  Taught us a lot about Seville, Carmona and Spain, in general.  He arranged lunch for us in a local spot and suggested local specialties which we were very glad we tried.  The private tour was worth every Euro we spent!
author: 571vals

title: Excellent experience!
text: Fantastic family trip to Carmona! Enrique was an excellent guide and driver: friendly, knowledgeable, and very attentive. He brought the history of Carmona to life and made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable from start to finish. We felt well taken care of and truly enjoyed every moment. Highly recommend Vandalia!
author: abey77

title: Vandalia Tours get 10 star rating!
text: I defy you to find a more fun, exciting, and knowledgable company for your adventures than Vandalia Tours. If there was a 10 star rating, they would certainly get our vote!
author: Sharon S

title: Amazing Carmona
text: Absolutely superb, Enrique is very knowledgeable and also very friendly. The amount of history in Carmona was far more than I expected. The pace was very comfortable and the information provided was in the form of a conversation, rather than being talked at. Thank you for a wonderful day.
author: john

title: Exceptional experience and guide
text: Enrique was an exceptional guide, being a life long resident of Carmona and extremely knowledgeable on all aspects of the area.  It was very informative and he was very interactive with our small group.  Enrique made our day!
author: dougd1672

title: Excellent
text: I took the excursion with my partner, a wonderful city and guide. I would repeat this experience a thousand times without a doubt, highly recommended.
author: D9606ERmartas

title: Town with great historical heritage, very trained and friendly guide
text: Very good excursion, Enrique is charming and knows everything about Carmona and its history. Town with many monuments to visit, it can be done well in one day. 100% recommendable. Thanks to the guide for his sympathy!
author: Climber795206

title: Exceptional guided tour!!
text:
A friend of mine traveled to Carmona and wanted to see the city first-hand. They recommended that we do it with Vandalia Tours.
Thanks to our guide (Enrique) he took us not only into the corners and monuments of the city, but also into the different stages of history, legends, characters, and endless knowledge that he possesses, since he is a great connoisseur of the history and links different points that make you more interested and want to know other beautiful places. Thank you for bringing us closer to those unknown times and making us travel back in time.

title: Fantastic experience with a wonderful guide
text: We had a fantastic three days with Enrique when we visited Seville. I was a bit concerned as I booked three tours beforehand and just hoped that they would be good. They were all excellent. We spent a day in Seville visiting the main sights, then had a day in Carmona (I never thought that spending a morning in a cemetery could be so interesting!) and then a day in Italica. His knowledge on so many things including the history and the locations we visited was amazing.  So pleased I contacted hom and will do so again when we are back in the area.
author: FrancesFray
